message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code only handles local file uploads; there is no fetching from remote URLs, S3, or other external sources, so no integrity verification or authentication of remote sources is present or needed in this slice.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs only NaN-filling and column-type filtering; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains KMeans models from scratch at runtime and does not load any pretrained/serialized model weights, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is performed or needed, but none is present.
No detected label distribution validation: The code performs clustering and statistics on uploaded data but never checks label distributions, class balance, or expected label sets before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; the code simply computes clustering and statistics on uploaded data without any such controls.

No detected output bounds checks: No checks are performed on model outputs (clustering predictions, statistics, association rules) for NaN values, out-of-range probabilities, or other sanity bounds before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML models (KMeans, decision tree, association rules), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
